       SUM(A4 = '' OR A4 GLOB '*[^0-9]*') AS invalid_population,
       SUM(typeof(A11) <> 'integer') AS noninteger_salaries,
       SUM(typeof(A13) <> 'real' OR A13 <> ROUND(A13, 2)) AS rates_outside_scale,
       MIN(A11) AS min_salary, MAX(A11) AS max_salary,
       MIN(A13) AS min_rate, MAX(A13) AS max_rate
FROM main.district

WITH eligible_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.district_id
    FROM main.client AS c
    JOIN main.disp AS d ON d.client_id = c.client_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
      AND d.type = 'OWNER'
      AND d.disp_id IN (SELECT disp_id FROM main.card)
      AND d.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM main.loan)
),
ranked_districts AS (
    SELECT
        d.A3 AS region,
        d.A2 AS district_name,
        d.A11 AS salary,
        d.A13 AS unemployment_rate,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY d.A3
            ORDER BY CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) DESC, d.A2 ASC
        ) AS population_rank
    FROM main.district AS d
    JOIN eligible_districts AS e ON e.district_id = d.district_id
),

arguments.sql:
WITH eligible_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.district_id
    FROM main.client AS c
    JOIN main.disp AS d ON d.client_id = c.client_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
      AND d.type = 'OWNER'
      AND d.disp_id IN (SELECT disp_id FROM main.card)
      AND d.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM main.loan)
),
ranked_districts AS (
    SELECT
        d.A3 AS region,
        d.A2 AS district_name,
        d.A11 AS salary,
        d.A13 AS unemployment_rate,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY d.A3
            ORDER BY CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) DESC, d.A2 ASC
        ) AS population_rank
    FROM main.district AS d
    JOIN eligible_districts AS e ON e.district_id = d.district_id
)
SELECT
    region,
    ROUND(AVG(salary), 2) AS avg_district_salary,
    ROUND(AVG(ROUND(unemployment_rate * 100))) / 100.0 AS avg_unemployment_rate_1996,
    MAX(CASE WHEN population_rank = 1 THEN district_name END) AS most_populous_district
FROM ranked_districts
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY region
LIMIT 1000

),

    FROM main.district AS d
    JOIN eligible_districts AS e ON e.district_id = d.district_id
)
SELECT
    region,
    ROUND(AVG(salary), 2) AS avg_district_salary,
    ROUND(AVG(ROUND(unemployment_rate * 100))) / 100.0 AS avg_unemployment_rate_1996,
    MAX(CASE WHEN population_rank = 1 THEN district_name END) AS most_populous_district
FROM ranked_districts
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY region
LIMIT 1000

SQL: WITH eligible_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.district_id
    FROM main.client AS c
    JOIN main.disp AS d ON d.client_id = c.client_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
      AND d.type = 'OWNER'
      AND d.disp_id IN (SELECT disp_id FROM main.card)
      AND d.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM main.loan)
),
ranked_districts AS (
    SELECT
        d.A3 AS region,
        d.A2 AS district_name,
        d.A11 AS salary,
        d.A13 AS unemployment_rate,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY d.A3
            ORDER BY CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) DESC, d.A2 ASC
        ) AS population_rank
    FROM main.district AS d
    JOIN eligible_districts AS e ON e.district_id = d.district_id
)
SELECT
    region,
    ROUND(AVG(salary), 2) AS avg_district_salary,
    ROUND(AVG(ROUND(unemployment_rate * 100))) / 100.0 AS avg_unemployment_rate_1996,
    MAX(CASE WHEN population_rank = 1 THEN district_name END) AS most_populous_district
FROM ranked_districts
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY region
LIMIT 1000
